_about: Public-domain William Van Mildert (1765-1836), Bishop of Durham and founder of Durham University, for the Word Hoard: his Theological Works (Oxford: John Henry Parker, 1838, six volumes: the Boyle Lectures on the rise and progress of infidelity, the Bampton Lectures on Scripture interpretation, sermons and charges), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 41 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
